answer: Because each thread escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the jade ledger records every share and the lantern audit reveals the split. A bond must be split across 2 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 124 aliases means 124 times 2 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
